privacy.title: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo gbɔgblɔ
privacy.description: Kukuɖenuŋu aɖeke meli o, boblododowo ƒe kadodo aɖeke meli o, cookies aɖeke meli si dzi woato akplɔ ame ɖo o, asibidɛwo ƒe dzesi aɖeke meli o.
privacy.intro: ZecHub nye hehenana ƒe dɔwɔƒe si woate ŋu azã faa na ga si kpɔa ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo ta, eyata míelé nyatakakadzraɖoƒea ŋutɔ ɖe dzidzenu ma ke nu. Axa sia ƒo nu tso amesiwo ate ŋu ade dzesii be èva srãe kpɔ ŋu eme kɔ ƒã.
privacy.s1b: Numekuku aɖeke mele nyatakakadzraɖoƒe sia ŋu o, boblododo aɖeke meli o, cookies aɖeke si wotsɔ léa ŋku ɖe ame ŋu, asibidɛwo ƒe dzesi aɖeke, kple ame bubuwo ƒe mɔ̃ aɖeke mele nyatakakadzraɖoƒe sia o. Wiki la xexlẽ mehiã akɔntabubu aɖeke o, eye míetua wò nɔnɔmetata aɖeke o. Míetia wò be nàge ɖe browser ad-topics APIs me o (wowɔa nuwɔametɔwo le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea katã).
privacy.s2b: Míaƒe amedzrodzeƒedɔwɔƒe (Vercel) ye subɔa nyatakakadzraɖoƒea, si, abe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ɖesiaɖe ene la, wɔa dɔ tso network biabia siwo hiã be woatsɔ aɖo axa ɖesiaɖe gbɔ ŋu eye wòdzraa dɔwɔwɔ ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi siwo nɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ɖo. Kadodowo nye HTTPS-ko (wozi wo dzi to HSTS dzi). Ne èzi kadodo aɖe si do le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea dzi la, nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si nèkpɔ tso nyatakakadzraɖoƒea koe wò web-browser ɖona ɖa, ke menye axa si koŋ dzi nènɔ la gbeɖe o.
privacy.s3b: Woxɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo kple adzɔnu ƒe nɔnɔmetata siwo le dɔwɔƒe sia ɖe afisia. Nyati ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo kple gakotoku ƒe dzesiwo ƒe agba tso zechub.wiki. Eyata axa aɖe gɔmeɖeɖe wɔa biabia ɖe zechub.wiki ɖe nunɔamesi mawo ta. Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe gbãtɔ hã zãa Wikimedia ƒe dzesi ʋɛ aɖewo kple nɔnɔme ƒe akɔtagbalẽvi siwo le agbe tso shields.io.
privacy.s4b: Nyati aɖewo tsɔa YouTube videowo dea eme. Embed la xɔa agba ne èʋu nyatia, si naa kadodo tẽ kple YouTube. YouTube wɔa dɔ le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ameŋunyatakakawo ŋuti ɖoɖo te. ZecHub nyatakakadzraɖoƒe gbãtɔ zãa teƒe si woate ŋu azi be woatsɔ akɔe na embeds siawo. Dɔwɔƒe sia mewɔa esia o.
privacy.s5: Nusiwo woate ŋu awɔ le wo ɖokui si
privacy.s5b: Dɔwɔƒe sia melɔ ZecHub nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ, gakotoku ƒe lɔlɔ̃, alo AI ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ ɖe eme o. Akɔntabubu aɖeke mele esi o eye nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nuwɔna aɖeke hã mele esi o. Gakotokua ƒe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔwo kple axaa me nyawo nye fotoɖeɖe kpui aɖe. Live network data tso dutoƒo ZecHub APIwo gbɔ.
privacy.s6b: Dɔwɔƒe sia nye dutoƒonuƒoƒo. Àteŋu axlẽ kɔdasia le nudzraɖoƒea eye nàdzro eme, eye àteŋu axlẽ ameŋunyatakakawo ŋuti nyatakaka gbãtɔ le zechub.wiki. Axa sia ɖɔ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe teƒea abe alesi wòle nu wɔm fifia ene.

hackathon.title: ZecHub ƒe Hackathon ƒe ʋuʋu
hackathon.description: Ƒe 2026 ƒe ZecHub Hackathon la wu enu. Dzro dɔ siwo woɖo ɖa me eye nàkpɔ nusiwo nutoa me tɔwo tu.
hackathon.prizeCopy: Nutoa me ƒe fetu ƒe ƒuƒoƒo. Nutoa me ƒe akɔdada wu enu le July 24, 2026 le 12:00 UTC.
hackathon.rulesTitle: Na wòanɔ dzɔdzɔe eye wòanɔ bɔbɔe be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu.
hackathon.note: Ƒe 2026 ƒe nudzraɖoƒe si li fifia yɔ dukɔa ƒe dɔ 34. Nyatakaka bliboa le axa gbãtɔa dzi.
hackathon.t1c: Nodes, indexers, RPC tooling, kple kakaɖedzi na xɔtulawo kple dɔwɔlawo.
hackathon.t2c: Nuteƒekpɔkpɔ siwo me wowɔa nu aduadu le kple fefe ƒe ʋuƒo siwo me Zcash nye modzakaɖeɖea ƒe akpa aɖe le.
hackathon.t3c: Threshold signing, custody patterns, kple safuiwo dzikpɔkpɔ si le dedie wu le Zcash dzi.
hackathon.t4c: Auth kple identity flows siwo zãa Zcash primitives hena gege ɖe eme alo gege ɖe eme.
hackathon.t5c: Nyatakaka nana, avuléle, kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo na ƒuƒoƒo siwo kpɔa ZEC gbɔ.
hackathon.r1: Ele be dɔwo nawɔ nu kple Zcash network la le mɔ si ŋu gɔmesese le nu.
hackathon.r2: Dɔ mamlɛtɔ ɖeka koe ƒuƒoƒowo ate ŋu aɖo ɖe ƒuƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe.
hackathon.r3: Ele be ɖoɖo kple zazã ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi siwo me kɔ nanɔ agbalẽ siwo katã woɖo ɖa la me.
hackathon.r4: Zã mɔɖegbalẽ si woate ŋu azã le mɔ gbadza nu ɣesiaɣi si wòanya wɔ be nàde nuwɔwɔ aduadu ƒe dzi ƒo.
hackathon.r5: De bubu ameŋunyatakakawo, dedienɔnɔ, kple nutoa me ƒe mɔfiamewo ŋu le kɔpiwo kple emenyawo siaa me.
